items.label: Поле 1А — Лесное святилище
items.prompt:
Create a 16:9 full-screen background illustration for a static 2D dark fantasy RPG battle, NO figures, NO interface, NO text. HAND-DRAWN MAGICAL DARK FANTASY. The art direction is dominated by LARGE QUIET PAINTED SHAPES and expressive ORGANIC silhouettes. Broad matte colour areas with gentle painted transitions, softly grouped shadows, selective contour accents. Think an atmospheric hand-painted animation background with restraint, NOT a rendered realistic concept-art texture painting. Ground is nearly untextured with broad subtle tonal transitions. Foliage is drawn as a few joined flowing masses, with only 3-5 leaf indications on selected outer edges, NEVER individual leaves everywhere. Brushwork follows the volume in long connected strokes. Detail only on ONE focal landmark, and even there prioritize large design shapes. No visual noise, stippling, grain, stippled foliage, bark scratch textures, all-over short brush dabs, tiny grass blades, gravel, patchwork ground, mosaic, squared strokes, low-poly facets, repeated twigs, microtexture, harsh sharpening, photorealism or 3D rendering. Edges can be crisp where structurally useful; quiet surfaces should not merely be blurred noisy textures.
Camera slightly elevated side view, not top-down. Lower 50 percent is a single clear walkable battle plane spanning the width for a party on left and enemies on right. Landmarks in upper half. Vegetation is confined to edges and backdrop, not obscuring combatants. A restrained palette with clearly separated broad values. The image should feel sinister and strange, with coherent physical transitions of materials and organisms. Magical biological refraction has merged the fantasy world: existing structures and organisms have transformed into each other's substance and anatomy, rather than acquiring decorative crystals or random protrusions.
LOCATION ONE, DESIGN A: The Pilgrims' Shrine after a magical annihilation. An abandoned sanctuary at the edge of an ancient forest, seen across a broad quiet clearing of smooth grey-brown compact earth. Upper right: FOUR thick round stone ribs meet in one clearly joined crown, supporting one small bronze brazier from a vertical central chain. Two ribs have been transmuted halfway into the trunk and roots of an ancient tree: carved stone transitions into smooth pale living wood with the original carved grooves continuing as the tree's veins; a single broad root curls around the base. The crown itself has become a translucent smoke-violet mineral membrane while still structurally connecting the four ribs. A recognizable stone structure and a recognizable tree have grown into ONE impossible organism, not a tree placed beside a temple. Soft amber flame within. Upper left: two large smooth forest trunk silhouettes fused together into one arch with a dark narrow space between them, background canopy appears as two or three soft contiguous masses fading into mist. A plain wide pilgrim track crosses the rear edge of the clearing in one shallow natural curve toward the shrine; no sharp turns. Quiet dark ground, dusty desaturated sage woodland, bone-grey altered timber, one muted violet mineral crown. No rubble, no scattered stones, no grass carpet. A spare composition with a deeply uncanny but believable story. FULL BLEED landscape illustration.

items.label: Поле 2Б — Затопленный сад
items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a 16:9 full-screen background illustration for a static 2D dark fantasy RPG battle. The input shrine image is a STYLE AND SIMPLICITY REFERENCE ONLY; create a different LOCATION, do not copy the shrine or composition literally. Retain its broad quiet painted ground, restrained hand-painted light and organic contours. HAND-DRAWN MAGICAL DARK FANTASY. Large coherent painted colour masses, simplified soft shadows and selective meaningful detail. Atmosphere should be eerie, ominous and unnaturally still, not cute or cheerful. Not photorealism, not a 3D render, not a heavily textured concept-art render.
CRITICAL: quiet surfaces with broad connected strokes and soft value transitions. No all-over tiny leaves, grass blades, short brush dabs, gravel, scratches, grain, square coloured patches, stippling or visual noise. Ground drawn as ONE coherent calm surface. Group foliage into a few continuous silhouettes; only sparse outline leaf indications. No low-poly or geometric facets. Do not fill empty space with ornament.
Slightly elevated side view; lower 50 percent is one uninterrupted shallow dry bank for characters to stand across, level from left to right. No characters, enemies, UI, lettering or borders. Key landmarks lie behind the playable bank in the upper half. Water begins BEHIND this dry battle plane, not across it.
The world has undergone magical annihilation: organisms and substances have blended into new disturbing forms, with visible material and anatomical transitions. Not merely abandoned scenery with a magical glow or decorative crystals. Strong simple forms reveal the transformation.
LOCATION TWO, DESIGN B: A different design for The Drowned Orchard, same illustration style and setting. Broad empty dry silt terrace in the bottom half, smooth muted brown-grey with a single large cool shadow, no marks or decoration. Behind the terrace lies a long black reflecting pool bordered by one low continuous curved pale stone embankment. Left background holds the unmistakable remains of an orchard: two short pruned trees and an old large bowed tree. Magical mutation has exchanged the structure of tree, water and stone. The main tree has a heavy white stone trunk with large rounded branch curves that become smooth dark living wood further outward, then merge into a single deep burgundy leaf canopy shaped as two heavy drooping membranes instead of many individual leaves. At the shore, a broad sheet of pond water climbs silently up one side of the trunk, becoming a translucent blue-grey wooden branch that arches back down toward its reflection: an impossible but continuous transformation of WATER INTO WOOD, clearly visible as one simple sweeping shape. No splashing, spray, droplets, glitter or swirling particles. One far tree has its roots turned upward like a bare crown, and its broad folded canopy submerged below the glass-still surface; keep this distant element graphically simple. Soft grey-violet mist separates the forms from an almost featureless deep forest backdrop. The scene feels like an orchard whose biology and gravity were quietly rewritten. Restrained ash, charcoal teal, dull burgundy and muted lilac-grey palette, no bright neon. Keep compositions spare, eerie and magical, with very low surface texture density.

items.label: Воин 1 — Клинок затмения
items.prompt:
Draw ONE full-body EQUIPMENT VARIANT of the EXACT SAME warrior from the reference. Identity locked: same middle-aged face, eyebrow scar, short tousled black hair with grey temples, short dark grey-streaked beard, nose, eyes, skin, muscular broad shoulders, age, height and proportions. Face fully visible turned three-quarter RIGHT. Change gear and stance only. Hand-painted magical dark fantasy in the SAME illustrative style, no photography or 3D. Full body and ALL weapon tips visible with margin, portrait 2:3, plain dark charcoal background, no text or scene.

VERY IMPORTANT CORRECT WEAR LEVEL: Armour is INTACT and SERVICEABLE. No long scratches, claw cuts, holes, cracks, fractures, missing pieces, bite marks, open gashes or battle damage through plates. Wear consists ONLY of a few SMALL LOCALIZED EDGE CHIPS in THREE limited spots: outside of one shoulder, edge of one forearm guard, front of one knee. Each little group only 2-3 tiny irregular chips; ALL OTHER metal areas have NO chip/scratch pattern. More than 95 percent of armour surface is calm unmarked matte dark metal with broad soft illustrated shading. No scattered white flecks, fine mottling, all-over grain, little cracks or polished showroom gleam. Keep deliberate construction detail and large shapes, but NO decorative texture etched over materials. Worn leather at handgrips and lightly faded cloth with one small sewn repair convey use. Cloak hem largely intact. This is cared-for equipment carried by a veteran, not ruined gear and not a brand-new uniform. Preserve the hero's tired scarred face rather than trying to put his history onto every surface.
Clear strong FANTASY equipment shapes and supernatural materials in LARGE designed features, not ordinary historical medieval kit. Restrained personal broken-sun insignia and faded oxblood cloth. Secondary weapons holstered/sheated with reachable grips. Correct hands and functional primary weapon grip. Magic inside material, no particles or auras. Matte paint, gentle large tonal variation, organic material weight; not flat sterile vector polish, not procedural weathering.
Keep the reference's heavy dark plate, pale beast-shell shoulder and oxblood half-cloak; keep face and body exactly. Shell shoulder is WHOLE, gently weathered ivory with broad organic lobes, no broken or missing pieces and no cracks. Broad two-handed fantasy sword with a dark smoky-glass center enclosed by continuous steel cutting edges, crescent bronze guard. Both hands around sufficiently long HANDLE, not the blade. One compact backup axe holstered at hip and straight front dagger. Same accepted design, ONLY the localized minor edge chips described above and softly faded cloth indicate age. All plates remain intact, no claw scar on chest.

items.label: Враг 1В — Грифон-василиск · Раздвоенная пасть
items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original frightening monster concept for a hand-painted magical dark fantasy RPG. The reference warrior image is a STYLE reference only: draw NO warrior, human character, armour or weapons unless explicitly part of the species specification. Match its drawn contours, broad painterly shadows, subdued dark palette and selected meaningful detail. Present the ENTIRE creature and appendages with margin, three-quarter facing LEFT, on a plain dark charcoal background; use portrait or landscape framing to suit the natural silhouette. No text, number, labels, scenery, ground, fog, particles, border or UI.
Art direction: an unsettling living fantasy creature whose anatomy has been rewritten by magical annihilation. Two fantasy beings are merged at a biological/structural level. Their tissues and materials genuinely TRANSFORM into one another; this is NOT mere recolouring, armour, cosmetic decoration or glued-on trophies. Clear new anatomy with plausible joints, muscle and weight bearing, asymmetry, unfamiliar predatory posture, unnerving face and mouth. It must be SCARY, not cute, noble, heroic, pretty or a generic dragon pet. Controlled body horror without splatter.
Avoid both visual noise and sterile plastic: use weighty irregular organic contours and broad low-contrast material variation, 2-3 meaningful healed injuries or weathered areas where appropriate. Skin, scale plates, wood and mineral are DISTINCT ACTUAL MATERIALS. Scales should be a limited number of broad coherent scutes, feathers grouped into broad fans, roots into a few structural limbs. Calm surfaces between important transitions. Detail selectively in face, jaws, major joints and tissue boundaries. NO all-over speckles, tiny scratches, grain, short dabs, etched fur, hundreds of scales, scratchy bark, fractal growth, dense little spikes, scattered eyes, neon or bright rim gloss. Matte hand-painted surfaces, rich fantasy DESIGN, no photorealism, 3D render, sterile vector finish or tiny textural chatter. Keep the creature visibly battle-scarred or naturally weathered without distressing every square centimetre.
DO NOT COPY any armour, cloth, sun emblems, human facial features or props from style reference. Creature surfaces are matte organic and drawn, no all-over chipped pattern. Preserve enough value separation from dark backdrop for the entire outline to read.
SPECIES: A griffin biologically interpenetrated by a basilisk. It must be disturbing and predatory, NOT a noble decorative griffin or a bird with green feathers. Clearly distinguish the actual tissues: a few broad overlapping reptile SCALES physically replace feathers on the basilisk regions. Smooth scaled skin replaces fur where reptilian anatomy dominates. Feathered areas remain feathered with a small number of large grouped feather shapes. ONE organism with continuous tissue transitions, not glued-together animal parts.
ANATOMICAL VARIANT: A compact heavily built stalking quadruped with griffin haunches and small folded wing remnants. A wide short skull is being rewritten: one raptor beak opens inside a MUCH broader basilisk outer jaw, forming a continuous two-stage anatomical mouth, NOT two attached heads. Both jaws threatening but no gore. Front half of torso and neck entirely broad smooth dark basilisk scales; back half has a few pale grouped griffin feather fans. One shoulder has reoriented upward into a protective scaled hood, asymmetrical clean silhouette. Large hooked foreclaws, low stare, wide stance.

items.label: М2 · Ледяное стекло
items.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target and identity reference: the attached female companion image. Make an alternative OUTFIT AND EQUIPMENT DESIGN for the EXACT SAME woman. Preserve face, apparent age, facial proportions, nose, skin tone, hair color, hairstyle, scar, body build and height. Preserve the same DRAWN magical dark fantasy rendering and flat charcoal background. Keep the full body and all weapon tips in frame, portrait 2:3, comparable figure scale. Change clothing silhouette, equipment and stance as specified, this is NOT a style variation. This is a seasoned fantasy adventurer, functional full-coverage equipment, no exposed midriff or sexualized armor. Strong fantasy construction and magical materials; no plain historical reconstruction. Surfaces must remain calm and broadly shaded: no grain, stipple, all-over scratches, tiny mottled brushwork or scattered tiny accessories. Only a few LOCALIZED small chips and one meaningful repair; otherwise serviceable equipment. No tatters or heavy damage. At most one simple insignia, do not repeat emblems across every garment. No hood, no scenery, no text, no labels, one character only.
Ice-glass channeler. Replace outfit with a dark petrol sleeveless knee-length split coat over fitted violet long sleeves, visible practical trousers and boots. A high crescent collar and only one large shoulder protector made from smooth translucent smoky-blue glass in a copper cradle. In one hand a tall forked staff with two solid curved glass tines enclosing a narrow cold-white magical seam; physical tines connect solidly to shaft. Other hand raised ready to cast. One spare short knife sheathed at hip, one repaired forearm wrap. Long vertical staff silhouette, light apparel, no knight's greaves or full plate.

items.label: В1 · Последний фонарь
items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE full-body female companion character illustration for a magical dark fantasy 2D RPG. Input image 1 is a STYLE/RENDERING REFERENCE ONLY: match this approved warrior's drawn dark-fantasy rendering, confident contours, shaped broad shadows, clear readable large forms, restrained painterly gradients and detailed meaningful fantasy equipment. Do NOT copy his face, sex, outfit or sword. This is an adult woman experienced in monster-haunted expeditions. Expressive authentic face, practical fully covering costume. Same studio-like flat charcoal background as reference, no scenery, no text, no labels, no other characters. Entire head, feet, all gear inside portrait 2:3 canvas, small margin, face toward the right in three-quarter view. Human proportions. Not photographic, no realistic skin pores, no 3D, no anime. Preserve quiet broad unpatterned fabric and metal surfaces: NO all-over mottling, stipple, grain, micro-scratches, texture noise, tiny trinket clutter. Detail concentrated in one or two meaningful fantasy devices. Used equipment: only two or three localized small edge chips, one visible repaired cut sewn shut, a reinforced grip or strap from experience. Serviceable armor, not shredded rags or broken gear. Fantastical garment construction and materials clearly belong to a magical world rather than historical medieval clothing. No sexualized armor or exposed midriff. No hood.
CHARACTER IDENTITY VESTA: female human healer and oathkeeper, around 47, sturdy broad-shouldered build, strong arms, broad square face, substantial nose, warm medium brown skin, calm steady hazel eyes, a small old scar through one eyebrow. Auburn hair threaded with grey in ONE heavy braid over a shoulder, face fully visible. Solid grounded protective presence. Palette warm bone, faded ochre, muted dark olive, old bronze; small warm amber sacred light. Clearly different from a young thin mage: heavier rounded/arched silhouette, layered protective equipment, no hood, no wispy tattered robe. VARIANT V1: keeper of the last lantern. Knee-length tabard over broad smooth ribbed fantasy armor: breastplate shaped like a sheltering folded bronze wing with one large bone ceramic plate, clear functional joints. Short heavy shoulder cape repaired in one place, calf boots, thick leather gloves. Hold a sturdy enclosed reliquary lantern with an arched bronze cage around a single floating ember; fantasy lantern is the focus, not dozens of ornaments. A serviceable flanged short mace hangs from the belt opposite a practical healer's satchel. A few visible staples repair one edge of the lantern housing. She looks like someone who can carry a wounded companion out of danger.
items.edit: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit ONLY the hair color of this exact character illustration. Remove the white/grey/silver hair streak at the temple and every grey strand: all hair must be natural rich warm chestnut-auburn, with ordinary brown/copper highlights, NO white, silver or grey lock. Preserve the heavy braid, hairstyle, exact mature face and apparent age, skin, pose, silhouette, clothing, armor, lantern, weapons, entire equipment, lighting, drawn style, dark background and framing completely unchanged. Do not make her younger. Do not add new objects or details. Full original image, change hair pigmentation only.
